list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat(cms): Prefix sidebar navigation links with /dashboard
Updates all navigation links in the CMS sidebar to be prefixed with `/dashboard`. This aligns the navigation with the new routing structure where all CMS pages are grouped under the `/dashboard` route.

task.summary:
feat(api): Add date filtering to tracking stats endpoint
- Modifies the `GET /tracking/stats` endpoint to accept `period`, `startDate`, and `endDate` query parameters. - Implements the logic in `TrackingServiceImpl` to filter tracking data by a predefined period (day, week, month, year) or a custom date range. - Updates the `TrackingService` interface and `TrackingController` to handle the new filtering parameters.
